note: Pre-registered test of the 🚀 strong-move detector (MOMO, web/index.html) on Binance USDT-M futures 5-minute candles. Trigger = the live one: |15-min move| >= 5% with 15-min quote volume >= 4x its 24h average, 24h quote volume >= $2M, the 24h move under +60% for longs (the late-short path is not tested). Entry = next 5-min open. Plan = the live one: half out at +10% (stop to entry), rest at +20%, out after 6 h. Only the stop and the re-entry rule change between variants. Change a variant = new id.
why: 19 Nov: MMT went +69% in a day and the detector lost ~3R on it (3 stop-outs) while Sonar's other engines held the same coin to the first target. 268 live alerts: 28% wins, -73.9R.
